notes.title: Changes and bug fixes
notes.content:
Changes in the last few versions

[h1][b]1.0.3.24[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a maximum timer for the intro video. If the game waits more than 6 seconds while playing the intro, it automatically skips to the main menu
[*] You can now start the battle with space button
[*] Heal card now repairs armors and shields too.
[*] A typo in prospect fixed
[*] New loading tips added
[*] ESC quit text changed
[/list]


[h1][b]1.0.3.23[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Shipyard portrait bug
[*] FTL engine event color correction
[*] Map black screen bug fixed
[/olist]


[b][h1]1.0.3.22[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a tip typo
[/list]
